title: Switching to something on the side before agreeing, with no idea yet: a discovery step and the new plan, unprompted
origin: Issue #93 live test, Nov 1 (probe 3); fixed in #37

answers.what: learn to use AI for my crew follow-ups

history.text: 5 min a day at 4, at home

That's everything I need, here's your plan:
• Today at 4 pm at home: 5 min asking ChatGPT to draft one follow-up text to your crew
• Then every day at 4 pm, 5 min
• Proof: a screenshot of the draft (easy to grab, and you'll see them stack up)
Each day's step builds on how the last one went. What do you think?

testerLines: Actually before we commit, I'd rather start something on the side. I don't have a business idea though or know where to start. Same 4 pm at home, 5 minutes a day
Yea tech and building things sounds good. I j don't know what problem to work on or what I could make
whatWentWrong: After "I j don't know what problem to work on or what I could make", ZOH replied only "I've saved all of that." No discovery step, no next question and no plan.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH takes the switch in stride (nothing was committed yet) and keeps the 4 pm, at home, 5 minutes setup. Not having an idea is fine: by its first or second text it proposes and shows the new plan by itself, as a • list, with a concrete 5-minute discovery step for day 1 (for example: write down three annoying problems you or your crew hit this week), the usual schedule and a proof that fits, then one question. It never points back to the old AI plan, never asks them to agree to a plan they haven't seen, and never replies with only a save confirmation. Once the new plan is shown and they sound positive, the commitment ask comes in its own text; a soft "ok" gets one natural re-ask.
